activities.name: Yurt camps at Song Kul
activities.note: the yurt camps run only in summer; Song-Kul is still snowed in in April

windows.reason: the most reliable months for a yurt stay, when every yurt camp and trekking route is accessible
the yurt camps open in mid-June and Song-Kul closes in late September; the edges of the season are less predictable
the ski base is in full operation with the best snow of the season
the season opens in mid-December, and March brings its last weeks

activities.name: Ala-Kul and the Tian Shan treks
activities.note: the high passes close in October and are still unreliable in May

windows.reason: all mountain passes are open and every trek and route is accessible
the trekking season begins, with Ala-Kul and most routes accessible
most routes stay open until late in the month, but the high passes begin closing

activities.name: Swimming at Issyk-Kul
activities.note: outside the summer the lakeside is beautiful but too cold for swimming

windows.reason: the lake is at its warmest, 22-25 °C, and the resort season peaks
the beach season starts in June with water around 18-20 °C, and the lake stays swimmable into early September
